title: In multiple locations, there is a possible use-after-free due to a race condition. (CVE-2026-55275)
description: CVE-2026-55275 is a use-after-free vulnerability caused by a race condition in multiple locations. It allows remote escalation of privilege without requiring user interaction or additional execution privileges. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 8.4 and affects unspecified versions. No patch or fix information is currently available.
